configurations.name: githubHost
configurations.description: For Github Enterprise users, if Github url is not passed, the default Github API "api.github.com" will be used.

configurations.name: authenticationMode
configurations.description: A GitHub App (recommended) acts as its own identity with scoped permissions, while a PAT acts as a specific user.

configurations.name: githubToken
configurations.description: GitHub personal access token with necessary permissions. This is only necessary if the integration is not functioning as an app.

configurations.name: githubAppId
configurations.description: App id if you want the integration to interact with Github as an app. This is mandatory if githubToken is not passed in.

configurations.name: githubAppPrivateKey
configurations.description: If App ID is passed, then app private key is required.

configurations.name: githubOrganization
configurations.description: Optional GitHub organization name for GitHub App or Fine-grained PAT authentication.

configurations.name: webhookSecret
configurations.description: Optional secret used to verify incoming webhook requests. Ensures that only legitimate events from GitHub are accepted.

configurations.name: skipWebhookPatching
configurations.description: When enabled, the integration will not update existing webhook configurations on GitHub.

configurations.name: resyncRatelimitReservationThreshold
configurations.description: GitHub REST rate-limit utilization percentage (0-100) at which resync processes pause to reserve quota for webhooks. Does not throttle webhooks or actions.

configurations.name: legacyDispatchWorkflowTracking
configurations.description: Enable for GitHub Enterprise Server versions older than 3.21 that do not support `return_run_details` on workflow dispatch (see https://github.com/github/roadmap/issues/1188). Polls GitHub for the triggered workflow run and serializes dispatches per organization/repository/workflow.

requiredSecrets.name: githubAppPrivateKey
requiredSecrets.description: "Private key in PEM format for GitHub App authentication and API access"

inputs.name: org
inputs.title: Organization
inputs.description: The name of your GitHub organization/user, can be found in the organization/user URL. For example - "port-labs" for https://github.com/port-labs

inputs.name: repo
inputs.title: Repository
inputs.description: The name of the GitHub repository that contains the target workflow

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.title: Workflow file name
inputs.description: The name of the file (under /.github/workflows/) that defines the target workflow, for example - deploy.yml

inputs.name: reportWorkflowStatus
inputs.title: Report workflow status
inputs.description: Whether to report the workflow status

inputs.name: workflowInputs
inputs.title: Workflow inputs
inputs.description: The following values will be sent upon the action invocation. You can use JQ to reference the action trigger data by writing double brackets, for example: {{ .trigger.by.user.email }}. You can reference secrets using {{ .secrets["secret-name"] }}. Learn more

actions.name: update_repo_external_custom_properties
actions.description: Update GitHub repository external custom properties based on Port entity changes

inputs.name: org
inputs.title: Organization
inputs.description: The GitHub organization that owns the repository

inputs.name: repo
inputs.title: Repository
inputs.description: The name of the GitHub repository to update

inputs.name: externalPropertiesMapping
inputs.title: External Properties Mapping
inputs.description: Defines the mapping of Port blueprint properties to GitHub external custom properties. Example: { "buisness_criticality": "{{ .properties.buisness_criticality }}"}

actions.name: bulk_update_external_custom_property_values
actions.description: Sparse update of a single external custom property across repositories. Batches automatically when more than 100 repositories are provided.

inputs.name: org
inputs.title: Organization
inputs.description: Default GitHub organization for repository values that omit org. Falls back to github_organization when omitted.

inputs.name: propertyName
inputs.title: Property name
inputs.description: The external custom property name to update

inputs.name: repositoryValues
inputs.title: Repository values
inputs.description: GitHub API repository_values array. Each item requires repository_name and value; org is optional and falls back to the org input or github_organization. Example: [{ "org": "my-org", "repository_name": "api", "value": "production" }, { "repository_name": "web", "value": null }]

actions.name: bulk_delete_external_custom_property_values
actions.description: Destructively remove an external custom property and all of its values across one or more organizations
